events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Alex Newhook broke a tie with 8:53 left and the Montreal Canadiens outlasted the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-1 on Game 7 on Sunday night to end the thrilling first-round series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens outlast Lightning 2-1 in Game 7 to win thrilling 1st-round series
